intents.name: delivery_issue
intents.definition: Customer inquiring about delayed, missing, or tracking status of a package/shipment.
examples: My package was supposed to arrive yesterday but hasn't arrived
Where is my order tracking link?
Package says delivered but nothing is on my porch
intents.boundary: Pertains specifically to shipping/fulfillment timelines. If the item is damaged, use damaged_item.

intents.name: refund_request
intents.definition: Customer requesting a money refund or monetary adjustment for a charge.
examples: I was charged twice, please refund my credit card
Can I get a full refund for this unused service?
I want a refund for the extra monthly fee
intents.boundary: Focuses on monetary reimbursement. If customer simply wants to stop an order, use cancellation.

intents.name: account_access
intents.definition: Customer reporting difficulties logging into their account, password resets, or credentials.
examples: I cannot log into my account even after resetting password
Password reset email is not arriving
Account locked out due to multiple attempts
intents.boundary: Standard user access issue. If suspicion of account breach or unauthorized charge, use account_security.

intents.name: damaged_item
intents.definition: Customer reporting receiving merchandise that is physically damaged, broken, or defective.
examples: Received a broken ceramic vase in my package today
The item arrived shattered inside the box
My device screen is damaged upon unboxing
intents.boundary: Physical defect/damage to the received item.

intents.name: wrong_item_received
intents.definition: Customer received an item different from what they ordered.
examples: I ordered shoes but got a kitchen blender instead
Received wrong color and wrong size tshirt
Package contained someone else's order

intents.name: cancellation
intents.definition: Customer requesting to cancel an order, subscription, or pending transaction.
examples: I want to cancel order 408-1122334 before it ships
Please cancel my monthly membership renewal
How do I cancel a pending purchase?

intents.name: pricing_question
intents.definition: Customer inquiring about product pricing, subscription tiers, or cost details.
examples: How much is Prime Video monthly subscription right now?
What are the pricing plans for annual renewal?
Are there any discounts available for students?
intents.boundary: General inquiry about prices before or independent of billing issues.

intents.name: account_security
intents.definition: Customer reporting suspected fraud, unauthorized transactions, or security compromise.
examples: Someone made an unauthorized purchase on my account!
I was billed for a gift card I never purchased
My account was hacked and card details compromised
intents.boundary: High-risk security or fraudulent activity. Requires immediate human escalation.

intents.name: technical_problem
intents.definition: Customer reporting app glitches, web crashes, media playback errors, or hardware malfunction.
examples: Music keeps pausing automatically every 30 seconds
The app keeps crashing whenever I open settings
iPhone screen is completely black and won't turn on

intents.name: complaint
intents.definition: Customer expressing dissatisfaction with service quality, agent interactions, or brand experience.
examples: Your customer service was extremely rude and unhelpful
I have been waiting 3 hours on hold, this is terrible
Very disappointed with the quality of support

intents.name: feedback_praise
intents.definition: Customer expressing appreciation, gratitude, or positive feedback.
examples: Your customer support team was super helpful today, thank you!
Great experience with the rep who solved my issue
Thanks for the fast delivery!

intents.name: unknown_other
intents.definition: Message does not match any known intent or contains insufficient, ambiguous context.
examples: asdfghjkl
Hey
Check this out http://example.com
intents.boundary: Fallback for unclassifiable or ambiguous customer messages.
